projects.title: UMPRUM Type
projects.description:
Type archive and studio platform for the Studio of Typography at UMPRUM, Prague.
Problem: 50 student typefaces by 25 designers, studio projects, a journal, and a library of 500+ books lived across scattered folders without a way for the studio to publish updates alone.
Result: Built a live Astro 6 and React 19 system with interactive dot/wave canvas typography, read-only glyph-accurate specimens, custom-themed Decap CMS, and a Google Sheets library (NAKI III Ministry of Culture project).

projects.title: 6000ovecek × EVRO661
projects.description:
Charity festival website for 6000ovecek × EVRO661 at Strahov Stadium, Prague, funding FPV drones for Ukraine.
Problem: A two-day underground music and visual art event with 23 artists needed a fast trilingual site that felt raw and game-like instead of a standard ticket page.
Result: Built a zero-build Three.js barn-door 3D entrance, torn-paper artist lineup panels with photo/video previews, canvas football mini-game, and full UA/EN/CZ language switching linked to GoOut and Donio.

projects.title: MASO.CORP
projects.description:
Speculative B2B supply portal and working offset print production tool for a fictional industrial meat conglomerate.
Problem: Combine raw anti-design corporate brutalism with a real graphic design utility instead of a static visual concept.
Result: Shipped a lightweight static web system with simulated B2B login gate, custom CRT 404 screen, invert mode, and an automated Flatplan and Imposition Renderer built with Vanilla JS and Chart.js (/guide).

projects.title: Cigarette Archive
projects.description:
Interactive 3D monument and digital archive transforming a years-long physical collection of cigarette packs into an act of letting go.
Problem: Document a physical cross sculpture and its memory-anchor objects online without flattening the spatial structure into a plain photo gallery.
Result: Built a React and CSS 3D spatial viewer with pan, zoom, free-angle rotation, and layer toggles, paired with a full visual inventory list and written manifest.

projects.title: Glagolitische Fragmente
projects.description:
Web digitalization and custom typographic edition of the 1857 book Glagolitische Fragmente by K. A. C. Höfler and P. J. Šafařík (UMPRUM Studio of Typography).
Problem: Historical Glagolitic manuscripts and 19th-century print scans are hard to inspect and compare alongside reconstructed letterforms on screen.
Result: Art directed the web edition and co-designed its Cyrillic typeface with Anna Ivakhno (Glagolitic typeface: Viktoria Naumuk, code: Oleksandr Hohulia). Interactive multi-page archive viewer with moveable zoom inspection across 73 historical pages.

projects.title: KhNURE Digital Ecosystem
projects.description:
Production-scale website architecture redesign for Kharkiv National University of Radio Electronics (proposal by a 2024 Computer Science graduate).
Problem: Legacy university WordPress loaded in 3 to 6 seconds with fragmented navigation across faculties, specialties, and class schedules.
Result: Engineered 35+ responsive UA/EN pages in Astro 5 and TypeScript with Headless WordPress REST integration, CIST schedule API, Cmd+K global search, and a live technical audit dashboard (/audit) under 10 KB JS per page.
